description: Is this action safe? Call once before any on-chain action: send the transactions, signature request, x402 payment request, recipients, and/or tokens the agent is about to act on, and get back one proceed/caution/avoid verdict. Transactions are simulated (reverts, assets out, approvals, counterparty screening), signatures decoded and checked for permit phishing, recipients screened against sanctions and scam lists, and tokens rug-checked, including tokens the simulation shows the wallet receiving. Returns one proceed / caution / avoid verdict with reasons. Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Linea, Unichain, Sonic and HyperEVM. Free over MCP for 10 calls per day; beyond that the tool returns the pay-per-call x402 endpoint and its price.

chain.description: Chain of the action (defaults to the typed data chainId, else base)

from.description: Wallet taking the action; required with transactions

paymentRequired.description: x402 PaymentRequired about to be paid

recipients.description: Addresses about to receive funds or permissions

tokens.description: Tokens about to be bought; each is rug-checked

transactions.description: Transactions about to be signed, in order

typedData.description: EIP-712 typed data about to be signed

name: preflight
